params.1273: End a fight against a skeleton in Lumbridge Catacombs with as many life points as you started it.
params.1274: You can do this in several ways:
params.1275: - Use a ranged weapon and trap your opponent behind a barrier it cannot pass.
params.1276: - Eat food to heal yourself enough to fulfil this criterion.
params.1277: - Rely on high Defence levels and good armour to avoid taking any damage.
params.1278: You must complete The Blood Pact quest to access Lumbridge Catacombs.
